scope: WAIT FOR on one supported BOOLEAN expression with bounded cooperative polling

reference_basis.documented: WAIT FOR delays continuation until its conditions are satisfied; syntax permits AND/OR global conditions
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native condition scanning, routine-call restrictions, scheduling, polling period and event/task interaction remain unverified

implementation_choices.syntax: WAIT FOR one supported BOOLEAN expression; ordinary aliases, fields/elements, internal functions and AND/OR short-circuit rules; native event/handler syntax remains blocked
implementation_choices.evaluation: Re-evaluate the condition once per check until true; condition effects precede each ordinary State.test budget check, matching WHILE; no yield after a true result
implementation_choices.yield: After a false budgeted check, call the existing synchronous sleep callback with 0.0 seconds; require None; default host time.sleep; DELAY 0 still makes no callback
implementation_choices.bounds: Every condition check and ordinary predicate-function statement uses the normal step budget; plain FALSE waits are bounded; no wall-clock timeout or callback-duration bound
implementation_choices.effects: WAIT marks routines as potentially host-delaying and propagates that effect; preserve earlier condition/callback effects, FOR write protections, active-counter cleanup and routine frames; source-located callback failures without retry; sticky current-instance ABORT stops further checks
implementation_choices.reports: One source-located waits entry per statement with body, condition kind/type, repeated evaluation, zero-second yield and step-budget flag; wait_policy records current choices

retained_boundaries: No native event/global-condition syntax, condition handlers, hardware I/O or motion conditions
No inferred device reads, controller/task coordination, native scheduling/timing or compiler acceptance
Strict remains future work; authored examples and synthetic callbacks establish offline behavior only
